commands.name: flowleap:patstat-portfolio-analysis (MCP)
commands.description: Resolve an applicant to one harmonized entity and present its patent portfolio with the right caveats.

commands.name: flowleap:patstat-guarded-sql (MCP)
commands.description: Answer an aggregate patent question with agent-written SQL through `patstat_query` (CLI: `flowleap patstat query "<sql>" --question "<question>"`) under the deterministic gate — the one-retry loop. You own the retry: errors carry the exact parser/Postgres detail, fix once, never loop (the 10/min budget is the bound).

commands.name: flowleap:patstat-graph (MCP)
commands.description: Answer "named node and its relationships" questions — citations, family, applicants/inventors, or the path between two patents — with the resolve-first flow: resolve free-form input to an anchor/psn_id once with `patstat_resolve` (CLI: `flowleap patstat graph resolve <input>`), then call the graph tool that matches the question.

content.text:
EP3477840B1, the University of Maribor welding transformer patent, has two forward citations in PATSTAT 2026 Spring. Both come from a single Robert Bosch family and both were added by the examiner during search, not by the applicant.

| Citing publication | Applicant | Published | Origin | Examiner-cited |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| EP3796345A1 | Robert Bosch | 2021-03-24 | SEA (examiner search report) | yes |
| CN112530684A | Robert Bosch (罗伯特·博世有限公司) | 2021-03-19 | SEA (examiner search report) | yes |

Both citing documents share the same title, "Welding transformer, method for producing a module for a welding transformer and method for producing a welding transformer", and belong to one two-member family. So in practice there is one citing invention, filed by Bosch in the same technical field, where a search examiner considered the Maribor patent relevant prior art. No applicant-origin or opposition-origin citations exist, and the forward list is complete rather than truncated.

For context, the Maribor patent itself cites nine documents. Five were examiner-found and four were applicant-supplied, and its family also holds the Slovenian priority filing SI25535A and the Slovenian validation SI3477840T1.
